types.sub: Zonke iintlobo ezixhaswayo, zihlelwe ngokusetyenziswa. Cofa igama ukulisebenzisa kwisivelisi.
how.title: Indlela yokusebenzisa
how.s2d: Chwetheza umbhalo, i-URL, iinkcukacha ze-Wi-Fi, uqhagamshelwano, nokunye. Vula Ngobuninzi ukwenza ii-barcode ezininzi ngaxeshanye.
how.s3d: Lungisa ubungakanani nemibala, uze ukhuphele i-PNG ekumgangatho ophezulu elungele ukuprintwa nokwabelana.
faq.title: Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo
faq.a1: Ewe. Ungenza kwaye ukhuphele ii-barcode ezininzi kangangoko ufuna, ngaphandle kokubhalisa kwaye ngaphandle kwe-watermark.
faq.a2: Sebenzisa i-QR Code yamakhonkco, i-Wi-Fi, noqhagamshelwano. Sebenzisa i-EAN-13 okanye i-UPC-A yeemveliso ezithengiswayo, i-Code 128 yokuthumela nesitokhwe, ne-Data Matrix yeelebhile ezincinci.
faq.a3: Ewe. Imifanekiso oyenzayo yeyakho ukuyisebenzisa kwiimveliso, ekupakisheni, nakushicilelo. Kwi-EAN ne-UPC kwiimveliso ezithengiswayo, bhalisa iinombolo zakho kwi-GS1.
faq.a4: Uhlobo ngalunye lunemithetho yalo. Umzekelo, i-EAN-13 yamkela amanani ali-12 okanye ali-13 kuphela. Funda umyalezo wempazamo uze ulungise idatha yakho.

articles.title: Amanqaku
articles.sub: Iingcebiso nezikhokelo malunga neebhakhowudi, i-QR Code nendlela yokuzisebenzisa kwishishini lakho.
